sentence: Only two tickets were ____ after the sale.
Their apartment is on the floor ____ ours.
Could you ____ me a glass of water?
I ____ this result as a useful starting point.
A democratic government should listen to the ____ it represents.
issue: 句中 the ____ it represents 可填 public（the public=民众），与义项“普通民众；大众”同义，首字母 p、6 字母均符合，答案不唯一。
fix_suggestion: 改句为“The census counts all the ____ living in the country.”（public 不能用于 counts all the __ living in…）；或接受 public 为第二答案。

sentence: We need to ____ with the neighbors about the noise.
The weather vane will ____ in the direction of the wind.

gloss_zh: 得体的；符合社会规范的
sentence: It would not be ____ to accuse her without evidence.
issue: 句意为道德上的“正确”（It would not be right to accuse…），与义项“得体的；符合社会规范的”（socially proper）错位，考的是 right 的一般“正确”义而非社会规范义。
fix_suggestion: 改句为“It would not be ____ to wear shorts to a formal dinner.”（社会场合得体义）；或将义项改为“正确的；正当的”。

sentence: Please ____ close attention to the instructions.
issue: 句中 pay attention 意为“注意；留心”，与中文义项“奉献；致力于”（dedicate）错位；学习者按义项无法推出 pay attention。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“付出（注意）；给予（pay attention：注意）”，并注明本题考固定搭配 pay attention。

sentence: The scientists will ____ water from several wells.
The detectives plan to ____ the witness again.
issue: question the witness 意为“审问；盘问证人”，与中文义项“提出一个问题”（pose a question）错位。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“审问；盘问”，gloss_en 改为 interrogate；或改句为“The reporter plans to ____ the speaker about the delay.”

sentence: Can you ____ the baby while I prepare dinner?
issue: watch the baby 意为“照看孩子”，与中文义项“观看；观赏”错位，考的是 look after 义。
fix_suggestion: 改句为“Can you ____ the film with me tonight?”（保留“观看”义）；或将义项改为“照看；看护”。

sentence: We shouldn't ____ so much money on advertising.
When we visit, we usually ____ at a small hotel.
issue: “We usually stop at a small hotel”在英式英语中可解为暂住（stop = stay overnight），与义项“居住；暂住”相符，为弱替代。
fix_suggestion: 改句为“When we visit, we usually ____ at a small hotel for three nights.”（stop…for three nights 不自然）。

sentence: The new policy will ____ visitors access to the archive.
The figures in the two reports do not ____.
issue: “The figures in the two reports do not align”为自然商务英语，align（一致）与义项“协调一致；相符”同义，首字母 a、5 字母均符合。
fix_suggestion: 改句为“The experts still do not ____ among themselves.”（align among themselves 不自然）；或接受 align 为第二答案。

sentence: They often ____ conversation with strangers at the station.
issue: make conversation 为固定搭配，意为“交谈；搭话”，与中文义项“从事；参与”（engage in）错位。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“进行（交谈）；搭话（make conversation）”，并注明考固定搭配。

sentence: The new policy may ____ rise to unexpected costs.
issue: 注：“____ rise to”为固定搭配 give rise to 的后半部分，题面即搭配提示；作为习语主动回忆题可接受，但应注明本题考习语而非自由搭配。

sentence: The authority will ____ a new permit once the checks are complete.
No one knew how the prediction would come to ____.
issue: 注：“come to ____”为固定习语 come to pass 的框架，题面即习语提示；作为习语主动回忆题可接受，习语本身偏正式/旧式。

sentence: The workers had to ____ the furniture to clean the floor.
issue: 句中 shift the furniture 意为“挪动；移动家具”，与中文义项“四处移动”（move around，不定向游走）错位。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“移动；挪动”。

sentence: The documents ____ the claim that the payment was made.
issue: 注：evidence 作动词（表明；证明）偏正式/罕用，日常多用 support/show；教学价值有限，建议备注语体。

sentence: The team must ____ the assigned work before Friday.
Many residents ____ the building unsafe after the inspection.
The hospital will ____ the patient to a specialist unit.
issue: 句中 transfer the patient 意为“转移；转送病人”，与中文义项“四处移动”（move around）错位；与 shift 一案同源（WordNet move around 义项误贴）。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“转移；转送”。

sentence: I would like a copy of the report, ____.
The orchard should ____ fruit next summer.
issue: 句中 bear fruit 意为“结果子；产生（成果）”，与中文义项“带来收益；产生收入”（bring in，指收益）错位。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“结出（果实）；产生（成果）”；或改句为收益义，如“The shares should ____ a steady dividend.”

sentence: The patient will ____ surgery next week.
The butterfly will ____ from its chrysalis.
issue: “The butterfly will escape from its chrysalis”语法通顺、语义合理（逃出茧），与义项“从……出来”接近，为弱替代。
fix_suggestion: 改句为非物理“出现”义，如“New details will ____ from the inquiry.”（escape 不适用）；或接受 escape 为第二答案。

sentence: Applicants must ____ their documents before the deadline.
issue: “Applicants must supply their documents before the deadline”语法通顺、语义自然（提供文件），与义项“提出；呈交”接近。
fix_suggestion: 改句为“Applicants must ____ their applications before the deadline.”（supply applications 不自然）。

sentence: We should ____ people with different opinions.
Did the witness ____ the time of the incident?
Several donors agreed to ____ money to the relief fund.
The fire could ____ the historic building.
She plans to ____ more time to her research.
He would not ____ his reputation on an unverified claim.
The campaign aims to ____ attendance at the museum.
issue: “The campaign aims to build attendance at the museum”在营销英语中成立（build attendance = 提升到场人数），与义项“增加”相符，为弱替代。
fix_suggestion: 改句为“A good breakfast can ____ your energy for the day.”（build your energy 不自然）。

sentence: Plant-based milk can ____ for dairy milk in this recipe.
____ the dry ingredients before adding water.
The separate groups decided to ____ behind a common goal.

gloss_zh: 使遭受不愉快的事；降临于
sentence: The court may ____ a fine for the violation.
The council voted to ____ a levy on empty properties.
They plan to ____ a new research institute.
We hope to ____ the city where we first met.
issue: 严重义项错误：中文义项“与……搏斗；抗争”与 revisit（重访）及句意完全无关，gloss_en “visit again”与之矛盾；疑似义项串位。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“重访；再访”，并核查该义项中文释义来源是否串入他词。

sentence: The car began to ____ as it joined the motorway.
The owner went to court to ____ the stolen property.
issue: “The owner went to court to recover the stolen property”语法通顺、语义自然（追回失物），与义项“再拿到手”同义，首字母 r、7 字母均符合。
fix_suggestion: 接受 recover 为第二答案（两者在此句完全同义，难以用句法区分）；或重写为 reclaim 专属框架。

sentence: The committee will ____ the application as incomplete.
The judge agreed to ____ the defendant bail.
Please ____ two studies that support your argument.
Her facial ____ revealed how disappointed she felt.
issue: 注：“facial ____”为固定搭配 facial expression，题面即搭配提示；作为搭配主动回忆题可接受。

sentence: Keep the seedlings out of direct ____ at midday.
Does ____ have a question about the schedule?
issue: 注：pos 字段缺失（null）。anyone 为代词（pronoun），WordNet 无此词条，需人工补标注；本题本身无误。
fix_suggestion: 补 pos = pronoun（代词）。

sentence: The manager will ____ each engineer a different task.
issue: 注：与 allot（v9-25）共用中文义项“分摊指定”，两词近义；本题凭字母数（6 字母）与宾语 task 区分，教学时应提示 assign 分配任务、allot 分配时间/份额。

sentence: Few climbers would ____ the summit in such weather.
The speech may ____ strong emotions among listeners.
The water level rose ____ after the heavy rainfall.
____, our train was cancelled just before departure.
A common mission can ____ several competing teams.
issue: “A common mission can unite several competing teams”语法通顺、语义自然（使团结），与义项“使一元化”（become one）同义，首字母 u、5 字母均符合。
fix_suggestion: 改句为“The reform aims to ____ the country’s tax systems.”（unite the tax systems 不自然，unify = 统一税制）。

sentence: The two companies plan to ____ next year.
issue: 注：与 unify（v9-12）共用中文义项“使一元化”；本题凭字母数与语境（公司合并）区分。

sentence: A cyclist should not ____ a bus at that junction.
Store the ____ rice in the refrigerator.
____ the handrail before stepping onto the platform.
Scratching the rash can ____ the irritation.
issue: 注：与 exacerbate（v9-18）共用中文义项“使恶化”，且两句可互换（Scratching…can exacerbate… / Air pollution may aggravate…）；本题仅凭首字母+字母数区分，教学时应提示 aggravate 常用一般语境、exacerbate 偏正式。

sentence: Air pollution may ____ existing breathing problems.
issue: 注：同 aggravate（v9-17），两句可互换；仅凭字母约束区分。

sentence: He likes to ____ about his achievements.
issue: 注：与 brag（v10-39）共用中文义项“吹嘘”；本题凭字母数区分。

sentence: The door can ____ around its central hinge.
The dry biscuit began to ____ in her hands.
issue: 句中 biscuit crumble 意为“碎掉；崩碎”，与中文义项“倒坍”（建筑物倒塌）错位。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“碎掉；崩碎”。

sentence: Click this icon to ____ the photograph.
One careless mistake could ____ the entire project.
The sensor must ____ for changes in temperature.
The organizer will ____ ten minutes to each speaker.
issue: 注：与 assign（v9-07）共用中文义项“分摊指定”；本题凭字母数（5 字母）与宾语 ten minutes 区分。

sentence: Symptoms may ____ without treatment.
Parliament voted to ____ the previously prohibited activity.
issue: 注：与 legitimize（v10-35）共用中文义项“使合法”；本题凭字母数区分，教学时应提示 legalize = 使合法化（法律程序）、legitimize = 使正当化。

sentence: He seemed ____ to discuss the incident.
The hikers began to ____ the steep path.
The lender may ____ the vehicle after repeated missed payments.
From the hilltop, we could ____ the entire valley.
Please ____ your reasons clearly at the hearing.
issue: state your reasons 意为“陈述；说明理由”，与中文义项“提出；呈交”（put before）错位；该义项与 submit（v8-14）重复。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“陈述；说明”。

sentence: The investment should ____ a modest return.
They tried to ____ the locked door open.
I cannot quite ____ the meaning of that argument.
issue: 严重问题：touch = 理解（comprehend）为古义/罕用义，现代英语不说 touch the meaning（应说 grasp the meaning），填空句不自然；该义项不值得作为 Core20K 主动回忆项。
fix_suggestion: 删除该义项的 Active Recall KU（Sense 降级为 Recognition 并注明古义，或整条移除）；如需保留 touch 的主动回忆，改考 touch on（涉及）或物理“触摸”义，另立义项。

sentence: His actions do not ____ with his promises.
____ we will meet again next summer.
issue: 注：与 perhaps（v10-09）共用中文义项“也许；可能”，两句可互换；仅凭字母约束区分。

sentence: The announcement may ____ considerable debate.
issue: 注：occasion 作动词（引起）偏正式/罕用，日常多用 cause/provoke；句法正确，教学时建议备注语体。

sentence: ____ the weather will improve tomorrow.
issue: 注：同 maybe（v10-07），两句可互换；仅凭字母约束区分。

gloss_zh: 得体的；符合社会规范的
sentence: It is not ____ to blame someone without evidence.
issue: 句意为道德上的“正确”（It is not correct to blame…），与义项“得体的；符合社会规范的”错位；与 right（v7-08）同类问题。
fix_suggestion: 改句为“It is not ____ to wear jeans to a formal dinner.”（社会场合得体义）；或将义项改为“正确的；恰当的”。

sentence: The university plans to ____ a new research center.
We usually ____ some gardening on weekends.
I ____ the meeting will start at nine.
A nurse will ____ the patient into the examination room.
issue: 严重义项错误：中文义项“使想起；提醒”与句中 wheel the patient（用轮椅推病人）及 gloss_en “wheel somebody or something”完全无关；疑似义项串位。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“用轮子推；推送（病人）”，并核查该义项中文释义来源是否串入他词（如 remind 相关义项）。

sentence: They chose to ____ in the village for several years.
issue: abide = 居住（dwell）为古义/书面语，现代英语 abide 常用义为“忍受；遵守（abide by）”；“abide in the village”对学习者极易误导。
fix_suggestion: 转为 Recognition（注明古义/书面语）；或改考 abide by：“Residents must ____ by the new rules.”（遵守义，需另立义项）。

sentence: The old paper began to ____ when touched.
issue: 双重问题：(1)“The old paper began to crumble when touched”语法通顺、语义合理（纸一碰就碎），与义项“倒坍/散开”相符，答案不唯一；(2) 中文义项“倒坍”与 crumple 本义“起皱；揉皱”错位。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“起皱；揉皱”，并改句为“He ____ the paper into a ball and threw it away.”（crumple into a ball 为固定搭配，crumble 不适用）。

sentence: Adding too much vinegar may ____ the sauce.
The fruit had gone ____ after a week in the heat.
issue: 句中 had gone rotten 意为“腐烂；变质”（字面义），与中文义项“糟糕透顶的”（very bad，比喻义）错位。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“腐烂的；变质的”；或改句为比喻义：“We had ____ luck with the weather all week.”（rotten luck = 坏运气）。

sentence: The new equipment helped us ____.
issue: 注：与 hugely（v10-22）共用中文义项“极大地”，两句可互换（helped us hugely / was enormously popular）；仅凭字母约束区分。

sentence: The first team agreed; the second team did ____.
A ____ figure stood beside the much taller adults.
The festival was ____ popular with local families.
issue: 注：同 enormously（v10-19），两句可互换；仅凭字母约束区分。

sentence: Several questions remain ____ after the investigation.
issue: 注：与 unsolved（v10-24）共用中文义项“未解决的”，两句可互换（questions remain unsolved / the unresolved case）；仅凭字母约束区分。

sentence: The detective reopened the ____ case.
issue: 注：同 unresolved（v10-23），两句可互换；仅凭字母约束区分。

sentence: The company will ____ considerable resources on the project.
Their holiday dates happen to ____ this year.
A prolonged drought may ____ the harvest.
The proposed restriction could ____ on freedom of expression.
The prize money was divided ____ the winners.
issue: 注：pos 字段缺失（null），应为介词（preposition）；另 amongst 为 among 的英式变体，是否单独立项值得商榷，建议备注。
fix_suggestion: 补 pos = preposition（介词）。

sentence: The broker hoped to secure a ____ commission.
The designer tried to ____ traditional and modern elements.
Her pulse began to ____ as the race approached.
Extra weight at the rear can ____ the load at the front.
The map will help you ____ yourself in the unfamiliar city.
The decree was intended to ____ the new arrangement.
It would be rude to ____ into their private affairs.
The academy will ____ its highest award on the scientist.
She would never ____ a colleague for asking a simple question.
He tends to ____ about his expensive car.
issue: 注：与 boast（v9-19）共用中文义项“吹嘘”；本题凭字母数区分。

sentence: The two approaches are quite ____ in their assumptions.
In the film, the hero threatens to ____ the villain in the jaw.
The new rules should ____ with existing regulations.
Security staff will ____ visitors to the laboratory.
The fishing line could ____ a seabird.
issue: 句中 fishing line entangle a seabird 意为“缠住；使卷入”，中文义项“使混乱”不贴切。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“缠住；使陷入（纠缠）”。

sentence: The allegation remains ____ pending further investigation.
The lawyer contacted the family of the ____ owner.
The report alleged that guards had ____ prisoners.
issue: maltreat 意为“虐待；虐待”，中文义项“侮辱”（insult/humiliate）不准确。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“虐待；虐待”。

sentence: He decided to ____ his time until an opportunity arose.
issue: 严重义项错误：句中 bide his time 为固定习语，意为“等待时机”，与中文义项“居住；暂住”（dwell）完全无关。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“等待；静候（bide one’s time：等待时机）”，并注明本题考习语。

sentence: The politician continued to ____ instead of answering the question.
issue: bluster 意为“虚张声势；咆哮”，中文义项“吹嘘”（show off）不准确，且与 boast/brag 的“吹嘘”重复，三词义项无区分。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“虚张声势；咆哮”，并与 boast/brag 的义项作区分备注。

sentence: The emergency team responded ____ to the call.
The region is known for its ____ weather.
The researchers followed the participants ____ over a decade.
issue: 注：longitudinally 为罕用技术副词（纵向研究术语），14 字母主动拼写负担大；句法正确，建议转为 Recognition 或保留但备注。

sentence: No employer should ____ workers.
issue: mistreat 意为“虐待；虐待”，中文义项“侮辱”不准确；与 maltreat（v10-47）同类问题。
fix_suggestion: 将 gloss_zh 改为“虐待；虐待”。

sentence: We met much ____ than we had planned.
